material_systems.name: Acrylic Exterior Primer — Spot/Full for Bare Wood or Concrete

primer.type: Exterior acrylic primer — multi-surface (concrete and wood)
products: Benjamin Moore Fresh Start Exterior Primer
primer.notes: Used for spot priming bare areas exposed by scraping (failing condition) or full prime coat (peeling condition). On concrete, covers bare substrate after scraping. On wood, covers bare wood at wear-through areas and scraped zones. Coverage varies: spot prime uses less material (only bare areas) but rate per SF of bare area is consistent. Full prime on peeling uses more total material.

material_systems.notes: Standard exterior primer for RP. Covers both substrates. Not needed on sound/worn conditions where existing coating is intact.

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Incompatible/Unknown Existing Coatings

primer.type: Bonding primer — adhesion promoter for glossy/incompatible surfaces
primer.notes: Conditional primer activated when existing coating is unknown or incompatible with porch enamel. Required when recoating over: original polyurea/epoxy remnants (after scraping), glossy surfaces that resist adhesion, or coatings that fail tape-pull adhesion test. Full-coat coverage — not spot application.

material_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Bridges adhesion gap between incompatible existing coating and new porch enamel.

material_systems.name: Acrylic Porch & Floor Enamel — Repaint Finish

finish.type: Acrylic porch and floor enamel — abrasion-resistant floor coating
finish.notes: Universal RP finish for both concrete and wood porch floors. 2 coats mandatory at QT3 for durability. QT2 = 1 coat (touch-up/refresh only on sound existing). Coverage slightly higher than NC because existing coating provides sealed substrate (less absorption). Anti-slip aggregate broadcast into wet first coat.

material_systems.notes: Same product as NC SYS_EXT_PRFL_FINISH_PORCH_ENAMEL but coverage adjusted for recoat over existing coating. Satin is the standard residential porch floor sheen.
